title: Squid Game Doll
blurb: Mugunghwa kkoci pieotseumnida. The hibiscus flower has bloomed, sung sweetly by an enormous doll immediately before the shooting starts. It is the most unsettling nursery rhyme ever put on television, largely because the melody is genuinely pleasant and the mechanism it announces is not. Squid Game turned a Korean playground game into global shorthand overnight, and there was a period in 2021 when children everywhere were playing it in the street with alarming enthusiasm. Play it in a room and watch several people freeze without consciously deciding to.
origin: The doll's Red Light, Green Light song from Squid Game.
